summary: Journey Page Cognitive Evolution Dashboard - All 5 sections verified working. Backend 15/15 tests pass, Frontend UI displays correctly with real data from 4 API endpoints.

section_1_cognitive_stability_overview.description: TSI=61 displays in orange with 'Unstable' interpretation (correct for 50-64 range). Shows trend arrow, Stable Strength=46, Peak Performance=81, Stability Gap=+35, Gap Driver='Structural Misjudgment'

section_2_blunder_context_distribution.description: Shows Winning 51%, Equal 35%, Losing 14% from real data. Single-line interpretation: 'Instability spikes when ahead.'

section_3_top_instability_drivers.description: Shows 3 patterns: 1) Structural Misjudgment (Severity 24, Stable), 2) Random Move Critical (Severity 15, Stable), 3) Missed Forcing Move (Severity 9, Improving). Each has pattern name, severity score, trend badge.

section_4_cognitive_trend_timeline.description: Line chart shows TSI trend for last 30 games. Dark blue line (#1e3a8a), Y-axis 0-100 scale, subtle gray grid, no animations. Labels: '30 games ago' to 'Recent'

section_5_phase_stability_insight.description: Shows Most Unstable Phase: 'Middlegame', Most Stable Phase: 'Endgame'. Interpretation: 'Decision quality drops during middlegame transitions.'

/api/cognitive/trend.returns: data array with game_num and value (0-100) for line chart

/api/cognitive/blunder-context.returns: distribution {winning, equal, losing} percentages summing to 100
